questions.prompt: The SQL expert runs with --tools read,sql_schema,sql_query. The model asks to run bash. What happens?
options: pi runs bash after asking you
pi runs bash in a read-only mode
The call cannot work, because bash never entered the session
The model switches to bash by itself
questions.explanation: Tools not on the allowlist never enter the registry, so the model has no bash tool to call.

questions.prompt: Why does the SQL expert keep read in its list?
options: read is needed for sql_query to run
The skills section of the prompt needs read or bash
pi refuses to start without read
read lets the expert write files
questions.explanation: The model opens skill files with read or bash. Without either, the skills section would point to files the model cannot open.

questions.prompt: An extension registers a tool named bash. Plain bash is also built in. Which one does the session use?
options: The built-in, because it is older
The extension tool, because it wins over the built-in
Both, run one after the other
Neither; pi reports a clash and stops
questions.explanation: An extension tool with the same name as a built-in replaces the built-in.
